arxiv-2105-00846.title: Semantic Journeys: Quantifying Change in Emoji Meaning from 2012–2018
arxiv-2105-00846.creator: Alexander Robertson, Farhana Ferdousi Liza, Dong Nguyen, Barbara McGillivray, Scott A. Hale
arxiv-2105-00846.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alexander Robertson, Farhana Ferdousi Liza, Dong Nguyen, Barbara McGillivray, Scott A. Hale. The semantics of emoji has, to date, been considered from a static perspective. We offer the first longitudinal study of how emoji semantics changes over time, applying techniques from computational linguistics to six years of Twitter data. We identify five patterns in emoji semantic development and find evidence that the less abstract an emoji is, the more likely it is to undergo semantic change.

arxiv-2110-06114.title: Optimal Time Plan in Accelerated Degradation Testing
arxiv-2110-06114.creator: Helmi Shat, Rainer Schwabe
arxiv-2110-06114.description: Abstract Many highly reliable products are designed to function for years without failure. For such systems accelerated degradation testing may provide significance information about the reliability properties of the system. In this paper, we propose the c c -optimality criterion for obtaining optimal designs of constant-stress accelerated degradation tests where the degradation path follow a linear mixed effects model.

arxiv-2206-09812.title: ConvGeN: Convex space learning improves deep-generative oversampling for tabular imbalanced classification on smaller datasets
arxiv-2206-09812.creator: KRISTIAN SCHULTZ 1, SAPTARSHI BEJ 1, WALDEMAR HAHN 3, MARKUS WOLFIEN 3, PRASHANT SRIVASTAVA 1, OLAF WOLKENHAUER 1,2
arxiv-2206-09812.description: Abstract \justify Data is commonly stored in tabular format. Several fields of research are prone to small imbalanced tabular data. Supervised Machine Learning on such data is often difficult due to class imbalance. Synthetic data generation, i.e., oversampling, is a common remedy used to improve classifier performance.

arxiv-2305-13758.title: A study of audio mixing methods for piano transcription in violin-piano ensembles
arxiv-2305-13758.creator: Hyemi Kim, Jiyun Park, Taegyun Kwon, Dasaem Jeong, Juhan Nam
arxiv-2305-13758.description: Abstract While piano music transcription models have shown high performance for solo piano recordings, their performance degrades when applied to ensemble recordings. This study aims to analyze the impact of different data augmentation methods on piano transcription performance, specifically focusing on mixing techniques applied to violin-piano ensembles.

arxiv-2311-17825.title: A comparison between axion-like and power law potentials in cosmological background
arxiv-2311-17825.creator: Md. Wali Hossain, Afaq Maqsood
arxiv-2311-17825.description: Abstract In this paper, we compare the scalar field dynamics in axion-like and power law potentials for both positive and negative values of the exponents. We find that, for positive exponents, both the potentials exhibit similar scalar field dynamics and it can be difficult to distinguish them at least at the background level.

arxiv-2312-01223.title: Saturation results around the Erdős–Szekeres problem
arxiv-2312-01223.creator: Gábor Damásdi, Zichao Dong, Manfred Scheucher, Ji Zeng
arxiv-2312-01223.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider saturation problems related to the celebrated Erdős–Szekeres convex polygon problem. For each n ≥ 7 n\geq 7 , we construct a planar point set of size ( 7 / 8 ) ⋅ 2 n − 2 (7/8)\cdot 2^{n-2} which is saturated for convex n n -gons.

arxiv-2312-11877.title: A discrete approach to the prescribed Gaussian curvature problem
arxiv-2312-11877.creator: Tianqi Wu
arxiv-2312-11877.description: Abstract . We propose a discrete approach to approximate the solution for the prescribed Gaussian curvature problem in 2-dimensional manifolds, based on the notion of discrete conformality. Our approach gives a convenient way to numerically compute the solution by minimizing a convex functional. 1. Introduction 1.1.

arxiv-2403-12877.creator: Roshan J. Samuel 1, Mathis Bode 2, Janet D. Scheel 3 Katepalli R. Sreenivasan 4,5,6, Jörg Schumacher 1,4

arxiv-2502-18530.title: IMPROVE: Iterative Model Pipeline Refinement and Optimization Leveraging LLM Experts
arxiv-2502-18530.creator: Eric Xue, Ke Chen, Zeyi Huang, Yuyang Ji, Haohan Wang
arxiv-2502-18530.description: Abstract Large language model (LLM) agents have emerged as a promising solution to automate the workflow of machine learning, but most existing methods share a common limitation: they attempt to optimize entire pipelines in a single step before evaluation, making it difficult to attribute improvements to specific changes.

arxiv-2509-19282.title: OverLayBench: A Benchmark for Layout-to-Image Generation with Dense Overlaps
arxiv-2509-19282.creator: Bingnan Li Chen-Yu Wang Haiyang Xu Xiang Zhang Ethan Armand, Divyansh Srivastava Xiaojun Shan Zeyuan Chen Jianwen Xie Zhuowen Tu
arxiv-2509-19282.description: Abstract Despite steady progress in layout-to-image generation, current methods still struggle with layouts containing significant overlap between bounding boxes. We identify two primary challenges: (1) large overlapping regions and (2) overlapping instances with minimal semantic distinction. Through both qualitative examples and quantitative analysis, we demonstrate how these factors degrade generation quality.

arxiv-2512-03322.title: SSLfmm: An R Package for Semi-Supervised Learning with a Mixed-Missingness Mechanism in Finite Mixture Models
arxiv-2512-03322.creator: Geoffrey J. McLachlan, Jinran Wu
arxiv-2512-03322.description: Abstract Semi-supervised learning (SSL) constructs classifiers from datasets in which only a subset of observations is labelled, a situation that naturally arises because obtaining labels often requires expert judgement or costly manual effort. This motivates methods that integrate labelled and unlabelled data within a learning framework.

pmc-10562218.creator: Seung-Ho Seo, Seung-Jae Hyun, Jae-Koo Lee, Yong Jae Cho, Dae Jean Jo, Jin Hoon Park, Ki-Jeong Kim, On Behalf of the Korean Spinal Deformity Society
pmc-10562218.description: Adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS) affects approximately 2% of adolescents across all ethnicities. The objectives of surgery for AIS are to halt curve progression, correct the deformity in 3 dimensions, and preserve as many mobile spinal segments as possible, avoiding junctional complications.

pmc-10675314.title: Entecavir: A Review and Considerations for Its Application in Oncology
pmc-10675314.creator: Tânia Lourenço, Nuno Vale, Francesca Musumeci
pmc-10675314.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Entecavir (ETV) is a drug used as a first-line treatment for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) virus infection because it is a guanosine nucleoside analogue with activity against the hepatitis B virus polymerase. The ETV dosage can range from 0.5 mg to 1 mg once a day and the most common side effects include headache, insomnia, fatigue, dizziness, somnolence, vomiting, diarrhea, nausea, dyspepsia, and increased liver enzyme levels.

pmc-11046593.title: A rare case of filarial cervical abscess
pmc-11046593.creator: Ramzeen Nilam Hameed, Geetha Philips, K N Sreelatha, Soumya John
pmc-11046593.description: year-old woman presented with a right cervical swelling of 2 weeks' duration. There was no history of fever, cough or weight loss. On examination she was afebrile, with a right cervical lymph node palpable, firm to hard in consistency and mobile. Routine blood investigations were normal.

pmc-11465125.title: Evolutionary insights into Felidae iris color through ancestral state reconstruction
pmc-11465125.creator: Julius A. Tabin, Katherine A. Chiasson
pmc-11465125.description: SummaryFew studies have explored eye (iris) color evolution beyond humans and domesticated animals. Felids exhibit significant eye color diversity, unlike their brown-eyed relatives, making them an ideal model to study the evolution of eye color in natural populations. Through machine learning analysis of public photographs, five felid eye colors were identified: brown, green, yellow, gray, and blue.

pmc-11679320.title: Comparison of Methods to Assess Adherence to Infant and Young Child Feeding Practices and Provision of Low-Aflatoxin Porridge Flours in a Community-Based Intervention Trial
pmc-11679320.creator: Erica Phillips, Rosemary A. Kayanda, Neema Kassim, Francis M. Ngure, Paul C. Turner, Rebecca J. Stoltzfus
pmc-11679320.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Levels of adherence to recommended protocols in an intervention trial can affect outcomes and confound the results. To broaden the evidence about the selection and utility of adherence measures in varying contexts, we describe the level of adherence to the Mycotoxin Mitigation Trial (MMT) randomized intervention using caregiver-reported survey questions and compare inferences of adherence between multi-module surveys and interactive 24 h dietary recalls based on our program theory.

pmc-12418229.title: The management of psychiatric emergencies in Africa: A scoping review of restraint and seclusion practices in clinical settings and their impacts
pmc-12418229.creator: Shankar Chakkera, Julia Sieg, Theodora Khofi, Rosemina Ayieko, Brandon A Knettel, Anonymous, Deborah Aluh, Inge Petersen, Dixon Chibanda, Deborah Aluh, Anonymous, Inge Petersen, Dixon Chibanda
pmc-12418229.description: More than 116 million people in Africa live with mental health conditions. However, many African countries lack the infrastructure, training and workforce to effectively manage psychiatric emergencies. This has led to overuse of controversial practices such as physical and chemical restraint and involuntary seclusion, often violating patient rights.

pmc-12568016.title: Environmental and Serological Monitoring of Porcine Circovirus by Loop-Mediated Isothermal Amplification in Pig Farms
pmc-12568016.creator: Alexandre Lamas, Alejandro Garrido-Maestu, Gonzalo López-Lorenzo
pmc-12568016.description: Simple SummaryPorcine circovirus type 2 (PCV2) infections have a significant economic impact on pig production. Environmental and serological monitoring on farms is essential for controlling this viral disease. This study evaluated the use of a molecular technique called loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) for monitoring PCV2 in serum, air, and surface samples.

pmc-13187083.title: Preclinical in vivo dosimetry of healthy tissues in radiopharmaceutical therapy: implementation of a physiologically realistic mouse eye model in GATE
pmc-13187083.creator: Elodie Jouberton, Nicolas Sas, Tommy Billoux, Philippe Auzeloux, Sébastien Schmitt, Leslie Mazuel, Jean-Michel Chezal, Elisabeth Miot-Noirault, Isabelle Ranchon-Cole, Florent Cachin
pmc-13187083.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundTargeted radionuclide therapy is a rapidly growing treatment modality that has shown great promise in managing metastatic cancers. However, the affinity of certain radiopharmaceuticals for off-target healthy tissues necessitates accurate dosimetric evaluations. This is especially the case for [131I]ICF01012, an experimental radiopharmaceutical used for advanced melanoma targeted radionuclide therapy, which targets melanin in pigmented tumors and metastases but also in melanized healthy tissues, including sensitive structures such as the retinal pigment epithelium.

pmc-13298143.title: Rate–Distortion Limits for Task-Oriented Compression with Side Information
pmc-13298143.creator: Tao Guo, Zhangyao Song, Huihui Wu, Yang Li
pmc-13298143.description: This paper analyzes the semantic rate–distortion problem motivated by task-oriented data compression with side information. The semantic information related to a task is not directly accessible to the encoder but implicitly impacts the observations through a joint probability distribution. The decoder aims to simultaneously recover the observation and infer the semantic information under certain distortion constraints.

pmc-13441554.title: Subtype-Specific Efficacy of Topical Streptococcus Postbiotic Emollient in Adolescents and Adults With Atopic Dermatitis and Comorbid Allergies: A Post-hoc Analysis of a Randomized, Double-Blind, Vehicle-Controlled Trial
pmc-13441554.creator: Jiseung Kang, Yesol Yim, Haeun Lee, So Min Kang, Dong-Geol Lee, Young Mok Heo, Hyungwoo Jo, Seunghyun Kang, Hyeon Jin Kim, Dong Keon Yon, Christa J. Nehs
pmc-13441554.description: Topical Streptococcus postbiotic emollient (Strain CX) has shown efficacy for mild-to-moderate atopic dermatitis (AD) in a previous study; however, treatment responses according to allergic comorbidity status have not yet been explored. We conducted a post hoc analysis to evaluate the differential therapeutic effects of Strain CX in patients with AD stratified by the presence or absence of allergic comorbidities.

pmc-13579051.title: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists as adjunctive therapy in refractory hypertriglyceridemia following recurrent pancreatitis
pmc-13579051.creator: Daisuke Miura, Stephen Nicholls, Anju E Joham, Michael Braude, Chau Thien Tay
pmc-13579051.description: A 39-year-old Chinese man was first evaluated at a multidisciplinary metabolic dysfunction–associated liver disease clinic following 6 episodes of hypertriglyceridemia-induced pancreatitis over 9 years despite maximal therapy with statins, fibrates, and omega-3 fatty acids. Peak triglycerides reached 2329 mg/dL (Système International [SI]: 26.3 mmol/L; reference range, <177 mg/dL [SI: <2 mmol/L]).

pmc-13604771.title: A Novel Regulatory System in Brain Development and Death Driven by a Bioactive Peptide Linked to a Specific Isoform of Acetylcholinesterase
pmc-13604771.creator: Adam Mohammed Khan, María-Salud García-Ayllón, Owen Hollings, Sara Garcia-Ratés, Susan Greenfield
pmc-13604771.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Acetylcholinesterase (AChE) demonstrates non-enzymatic actions attributable to a 14mer bioactive peptide derived from its sixth exon, ‘T14’, a pivotal agent driving Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Methods: To investigate this possible parallel between development and neurodegeneration, we tracked the expression and timeline of T14 in embryonic and neonatal rodent brain tissue in relation to the expression of its parent molecule, AChE, benchmarked against markers of neural maturation (NeuN) and neurodegenerative pathology (pTau) using sedimentation profiling, Western blotting, and qPCR.
